# The John Marshall Barber Shop

> A classic American barbershop in Downtown Richmond, Virginia, open since 1929 on the ground floor of the historic Hotel John Marshall building at 5th and Franklin streets. Slogan: "We Cut, Shave & Shine."

## Key facts
- Name: The John Marshall Barber Shop
- Type: Barber shop (haircuts, hot-towel straight-razor shaves, shoe shines)
- Founded: 1929 (opened around the day of the stock market crash; a haircut cost 50 cents)
- Address: 502 E Franklin St, Richmond, VA 23219, United States (ground floor, Franklin Street side of the Hotel John Marshall building, at 5th & Franklin)
- Phone: (804) 649-7577
- Website: https://john-marshall-barbershop-website.netlify.app/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/thejohnmarshallbarbershop/
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=John+Marshall+Barber+Shop+502+E+Franklin+St+Richmond+VA
- Google rating: 4.4 out of 5 from 135 reviews

## Hours (please call to confirm)
- Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM
- Saturday: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
- Sunday: Closed

## Services and last published prices (call to confirm)
- Cut: $24
- Cut & Shampoo: $30
- Cut & Shave: $45
- Shave (hot-towel straight razor): $22
- Shine (shoe shine): $7
- Also offered: beard trims, head shaves, women's cuts (including bobs). Men's manicures are listed in directories; call to confirm.

## How to book
- Call (804) 649-7577. Appointments are recommended; walk-ins should call ahead to check the wait.

## Payment and parking
- Cards: American Express, Visa, Mastercard and Discover are listed as accepted (confirm with the shop).
- Parking: directory listings mention free lot parking (confirm with the shop).

## History
- 1929: The shop opens around the day of the stock market crash. The Hotel John Marshall (architect Marcellus E. Wright Sr.; 16 stories; 418 rooms; Virginia's largest hotel at the time) opened October 30, 1929. The shop was "never officially part of the hotel" (Richmond Magazine, 2012).
- 1967: Hugh Campbell begins barbering; he became the shop's long-time owner/manager.
- 1988: The Hotel John Marshall closes.
- 2007-2012: The shop moves temporarily across the street during the building's conversion. The building reopens December 21, 2011 as The Residences at the John Marshall (238 apartments).
- June 11, 2012: The shop returns to its original space. Restoration uncovered the original 1929 marble floor, mirrors and marble countertops; a damaged spot in the floor was patched with barber Hugh Campbell's handprint and initials.
- Today: Barbers wear button-down shirts and ties; customers include people from government, business and the nearby Capitol (Richmond Magazine, 2024).

## FAQ
- Do I need an appointment? Appointments are recommended; walk-ins, call ahead at (804) 649-7577.
- How much is a haircut? $24 (last published price); cut & shave $45.
- Are you open Sunday? No, closed Sundays.
- Where do I park? Directory listings mention free lot parking; call to confirm.
- Do you cut women's hair? Yes, including classic bob cuts.
- How far is it from the Capitol? A few blocks; walk west on Franklin Street from Capitol Square to 5th Street.
